owner_system: Instagram and the account owner — outside this repository.

surface_decides: caption rendering, media attachment, truncation, and final publish action
core_decides: editorial content, verification, content-type fit, and voice fit

constraints.format: caption or carousel-caption handoff; paragraph breaks may be used for mobile readability
constraints.length_hint: allow a complete personal thought; shorter than a full essay by default but never compressed into slogan fragments
constraints.citation_style: concise attribution or link-in-profile wording when factual claims materially depend on a source
constraints.register: personal-reflective; anecdote, parentheses, self-questioning, a restrained emoji, and a postscript are permitted when they are natural
constraints.hashtags: optional; historical author usage is not a requirement
constraints.call_to_action: normally none; do not manufacture an engagement question

publication_boundary: Only the account owner or an explicitly authorised platform workflow may publish; this repository prepares caption text only.

replaceable.note: The surface profile is replaceable by another personal social network profile without changing content-type truth or the optional suengj-style overlay.
